text:
[title] Result: 2.4x more requests per second
[body] Same hardware: 8 GPUs, same latency target
[body] Median response time unchanged
[body] Measured on a real chat workload

novice.takeaway: The presenter achieved 2.4 times more processed requests per second using the same hardware and latency, without hurting response time.
questions: What was the baseline before this improvement?
How was 'real chat workload' defined or measured?
novice.inferred_claim: The presenter wants us to believe their method significantly boosts efficiency without tradeoffs.

peer.takeaway: The presented techniques achieved 2.4x more requests per second on the same hardware without sacrificing median response time, validated on a real chat workload.
questions: What was the actual latency target value used?
How does p99 latency compare, not just median?
What counts as a 'real chat workload' exactly?
peer.inferred_claim: The presenter wants us to believe their optimizations deliver a validated, real-world 2.4x throughput gain at no latency cost.

expert.takeaway: The combined optimizations achieve 2.4x higher throughput on the same hardware without sacrificing median latency, validated on a real chat workload.
questions: Is this p99 goodput or raw RPS being measured?
What was the latency target value used?
How does tail (p99) latency compare, not just median?
expert.inferred_claim: The presenter wants the audience to accept that their system doubles-plus throughput at no latency cost.
